methods.label: Group convenient factors
methods.explanation:
Pair the factors that make simple products: \(8\times0.125=1\) and \(2\times0.25=0.5\). Changing the order and grouping of factors does not change their product, so
\[
8\times0.25\times2\times0.125
=(8\times0.125)(2\times0.25)
=1\times0.5=\frac12.
\]
The answer is \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
methods.levelReason: This uses elementary decimal multiplication and regrouping, appropriate for AMC 8.
